system.description:
The dwarves of Tenor Hold didn't wait for blackpowder to solve the problem of killing things at range. They solved it decades earlier with springs, gears, and spite.

  • Clockwork Precision: Repeating crossbow bolts fired in the same round against the same target deal +1 damage per bolt after the first — they find the gaps. No disadvantage on Called Shot when using a repeating crossbow.
  • Engineer's Eye: Advantage on checks to identify, maintain, repair, or modify mechanical ranged weapons. Can perform field repairs on any crossbow or firearm during a rest.
